import os
import sys
import tempfile
import pytest
from click.testing import CliRunner

runner = CliRunner()

def run_cli(*args):
    return runner.invoke(cli, args)

def test_init_creates_schema():
    result = run_cli("--db", DB, "init")
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    import sqlite3
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    tables = [r[0] for r in conn.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")]
    assert "contacts" in tables
    assert "opportunities" in tables

def test_contact_add():
    run_cli("--db", DB, "init")
    result = run_cli("--db", DB, "contact", "add", "--email", "a@b.com", "--name", "Alice")
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    result = run_cli("--db", DB, "contact", "show", "a@b.com")

    run_cli("--db", DB, "contact", "add", "--email", "a@b.com", "--name", "Alice")
    result = run_cli("--db", DB, "contact", "add", "--email", "a@b.com", "--name", "Alice2")
    assert result.exit_code != 0

    run_cli("--db", DB, "init")
    run_cli("--db", DB, "contact", "add", "--email", "a@b.com", "--name", "Alice", "--company", "X")

    run_cli("--db", DB, "opp", "add", "--title", "D1", "--contact", "a@b.com", "--amount", "1000", "--stage", "lead")

    result = run_cli("--db", DB, "forecast")
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    # 1000*0.1 + 1000*1 = 1100
    assert "1100" in result.output

def test_export_import_roundtrip():
    run_cli("--db", DB, "init")
    run_cli("--db", DB, "contact", "add", "--email", "a@b.com", "--name", "Alice")
    run_cli("--db", DB, "opp", "add", "--title", "Deal", "--contact", "a@b.com", "--amount", "500", "--stage", "qualified")

    assert result.exit_code != 0

import sqlite3


def get_db(db_path: str) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    """Open a fresh SQLite connection with foreign_keys ON and Row factory."""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")

    return conn

    conn = get_db(db_path)

            id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            email   TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            name    TEXT    NOT NULL,
            company TEXT,
            phone   TEXT
        );

            id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            title      TEXT    NOT NULL,
            contact_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES contacts(id),
